readBy: active buyers (thousands) as of December 31 from each year's 20-F; 2022 and 2023 taken as RESTATED in the FY2024 20-F (marketplace-only definition) so 2022–2026 share one definition; 2019–2021 as printed on the earlier definition; FY2025 20-F re-read by the lead (3,135 / 3,630 / 4,027); per-value filing URLs in sec-upwork-fiverr-citations.json
definitionBreak: FY2024 20-F renamed the metric annual active buyers and narrowed it to marketplace Gigs (services excluded), restating 2022 from 4,275 to 4,201 and 2023 from 4,077 to 4,027. 2019–2021 (2,352; 3,418; 4,217) are on the earlier definition, which included other services Fiverr now calls immaterial.
